stop_rules: No launch without exact account/source-upload/output and allocated spend authority.
Use one shared $10 aggregate ledger across all six plans, not a fresh $10 allowance per plan.
Hard backend/account limit or proven preflight upper charge bound must fit remaining allocation; otherwise plan stays blocked.
No hidden retries, extra models, cache/search/embedding/auxiliary work or expansion to another fixture.
Stop on first terminal result or infrastructure failure; preserve failures/refusals/abstentions and costs.
Timeout/cancellation does not prove backend billing stopped. Reconcile cleanup and provider account receipt.
coverage_limits: Development text fixtures are observation snapshots, not source-media inference.
Synthetic three-second AV is a provider contract smoke, not native-video superiority/natural speech/long-recording acceptance.
Human source audit and full independently sealed heldout comparisons remain mandatory at vrm-0e8.10.2.
Heldout manifests are commitment metadata only; inspector reads no heldout inputs, labels, snapshots or media.
